pure_core.record: Canonical exact JSON {schema:moli.launcher.preferences.v1,userMode:1|2}, fixed two keys/order and <=128UTF16 characters. Reject unknown version, extra/duplicate/escaped keys, whitespace/noncanonical representation, arrays, inherited/nonprimitive values and invalid modes without coercion or input echo.
pure_core.accepted_inputs: Only explicit numeric mode1|2 or an own-format string; no username/password/checkbox/encoding/consent values.

browser_adapter.provider: Lazy same-origin localStorage; exact fixed owned key, stable method/receiver snapshots per operation.
browser_adapter.read: missing|loaded|invalid|unavailable; invalid/current unknown record retained, no auto write/delete or fallback.
browser_adapter.write: Explicit save only; exact canonical setItem then same-port getItem readback. saved only on exact equality; pre-provider failure unavailable/no write attempt; write invocation/verification failure unconfirmed/writeAttempted true. No raw errors or fallback copies.
browser_adapter.conflict: Ordinary Storage last write wins; not atomic compare-and-swap, rollback, native INI mapping or power-failure durability. User-initiated save may replace own invalid/future record; never automatic.

UI.load: After valid local runtime descriptor, read only own non-secret mode. Missing/invalid/unavailable uses mode2 without auto write. Valid1/2 uses existing pure observed initialization defaults.
UI.save: Save input-mode control explicitly stores current numeric mode; inputs, retention checkboxes, account encoding, texts and consent are never passed to the store. Saving does not clear current fields/confirmation.
UI.change: Mode changes remain page-only until explicit save.2-to1 confirms; confirmed changes reset fields/consent/candidates. Cancel/Escape preserves fields and prior mode.
UI.locking: No save or mode changes during config/text IO, review, modal or actual exchange. Owned mode restored on invalid/locked synthetic changes; confirmation must own currently open pending dialog/current target/current mode. Stale/hidden confirmation ignored.
UI.restore: Reload restores numeric mode only; account fields empty, password checkbox false, username checkbox reset by mode defaults, account encodingASCII, configuration/text/consent not restored automatically.

evidence.original_peer_scope: One extra preferences flow request plus retained six encoding requests and five full config requests/one cancellation; independent Python original inputs/crypto only.

remaining: Whole-program actual account persistence and indirect field aliases; current direct26 offsets are a bounded inventory.
